argv: for c in $(git log --all --format=%H -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh); do s=$(git show $c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); n=$(git cat-file -s $c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh 2>/dev/null); d=$(git log -1 --format=%ad --date=iso-strict $c); echo "$c $d sha256=$s bytes=$n"; done | grep -n -E "sha256=(597e1419|b56c6e57)|" ; echo ----; git log --all --format=%H -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh | wc -l
